2121054006470713596.en_summary: $TE missed revenue by nearly 30%. Financing for the Austin cell fab is still not closed, talks exclusive and number one priority, build pace slowed to match financing timeline. Contracted 2027 capacity over 3.5 GW, unrestricted cash $59.5M. Contracted capacity proves demand but does not prove factory built on time without financing. Tax-credit question open. Long term if cells on time and financing closes, US manufacturer with contracted demand.
2121054006470713596.zh_summary: $TE 收入未達標近30%。奧斯汀電池廠融資仍未完成，談判排他性且為首要優先事項，建造進度已放緩以配合融資時間表。2027年合約產能超過3.5 GW，無限制現金$59.5M。合約產能證明需求，但不證明工廠在無融資情況下按時建成。稅收抵免問題仍開放。長期若電池準時到位且融資完成，則為具合約需求的美國製造商。

ticker_notes.TE: 需求由合約支持，但融資未閉合為主要風險

2121053629163434234.en_summary: $NBIS beat revenue but market sold on funding plan. 2027 revenue guided at $12–13B against $40–45B capex, $7B ARR target slipped a few months. Cash $7.4B. Contracted revenue proves demand but not that build is funded. Customers financing expansion via prepayments and contract-backed financing. Risk is gap between building now and getting paid later.

ticker_notes.NBIS: 收入超預期但大型資本支出與融資計劃為關鍵
